verdict.rationale: vLLM is a headless runtime by design. It ships a CLI that starts its OpenAI-compatible API server, an official Docker image (vllm/vllm-openai) for server deployment, and CLI benchmark commands. Community users describe it as a web-server/GPU-process architecture, and nothing in the evidence suggests a GUI dependency. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI-pipeline usage patterns, and independent hands-on reports of headless CI runs.
